caption: The drawing depicts a bonnet with a wide opening, colored primarily in shades of gold and light yellow. The main body of the bonnet is decorated with diagonal gold and yellow stripes, and it is wrapped with a wide, solid gold ribbon that is gathered into a large decorative bow and rosette on the side. The inner part of the bonnet is shaded in tones of light gray to suggest depth. A long, wide ribbon in matching gold is tied under the bonnet in a large, loose bow with flowing ends. In the lower right corner of the drawing, there are two smaller, sketched diagrams of the bonnet, one showing a simple outline and the other including the bow and decorative elements. The background is a plain, off-white color, and the drawing is framed with a faint, rectangular pencil border. An artist’s signature, “E. Schwabe,” appears near the bottom right corner.
title: Child's Bonnet
